name: Closing
overview: The concept of closing, illustrated by the act of closing a door, symbolizes the decisive choices that define our relationship with God. Scripture reveals that through faith in Jesus, who is the way, the truth, and the life, believers gain access to the Father, while rejection effectively closes that door to eternal life. This is grounded in the profound love of God, who gave His only begotten Son so that those who believe would not perish but have everlasting life. The unity of believers, as seen at Pentecost, underscores the importance of being aligned in faith as the spiritual door remains open to those who come in one accord.
